meaning:
ἐν-έδρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἕδρα, a seat), [in LXX: Jos.8:7-9, Psa.10:8 (אָרַב)* ;]
a lying in wait, an ambush: Act.23:16 (Rec. ἔνεδρον, a form frequently in LXX), Act.25:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.
